description: An automated AST transformation in `@next/codemod` that updates `params`, `searchParams`, `cookies()`, `headers()`, and `draftMode()` to use `await` or `React.use()`.
A CLI command (`npx next typegen`) that generates static route types (`PageProps`, `LayoutProps`, `RouteContext`) from the `app/` filesystem without requiring a full build.
Auto-generated global TypeScript helper types that strongly type `params` (as a `Promise` of route segment keys) and `searchParams` (for pages) or slot props (for layouts).
A temporary migration type inserted by the codemod alongside `@next-codemod-error` when `cookies()` is called inside a synchronous helper function that requires manual async refactoring.
